players.product: US utility - UHV transformer buyer (Hyosung HICO end customer)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 segment results: the electric transmission segment earned $183.7 million excluding the FERC ROE refund charge, versus $208.0 million in Q2 2025, reflecting the reduced allowed ROE for New England transmission owners (10.57% to 9.57%) and higher interest expense, partially offset by continued investment in the transmission system. The electric distribution segment earned $170.4 million versus $161.5 million, mainly on base distribution rate increases in Massachusetts and New Hampshire and continued distribution system investment.
quarterly_data.figure: electric transmission segment earnings $183.7 million (vs $208.0 million); electric distribution segment earnings $170.4 million (vs $161.5 million)
